rules.says: Read a file with Read, list a folder with Glob and search with Grep; never ls, find, head, cat, grep, awk, sed or a pipe in Bash — a revision is searched with git grep
Run each check bare, one command per call: never wrapped in timeout, never cd or a for loop
Read, Grep and Glob reach the workspace and the folders the brief says you may read; never another run's folder, the store, ~/.claude, ~/.cache or a system path
